title: Improve Communication in 60 Days Using ChatGPT
summary: The creator claims that doing 15 minutes of daily exercises using the free version of ChatGPT for 60 days will significantly improve your articulation, confidence, and grammar. The method involves a 5-minute grammar assessment and practice plan, followed by a 10-minute spoken articulation exercise.
key_points: Commit to 15 minutes daily for 60 days using the free version of ChatGPT.
Exercise 1: Ask ChatGPT to conduct a grammar assessment (15 questions, one at a time) and provide a personalized 5-minute daily grammar practice plan based on weaknesses.
Keep practicing in the same chat thread so ChatGPT can track your progress and increase difficulty over time.
Exercise 2: Read a news article or book passage, close it, and use the microphone button in ChatGPT to explain it in your own words for 60 seconds without stopping.
Ask ChatGPT to evaluate your spoken response on clarity, sentence formation, vocabulary, and thought organization, and ask for specific improvement exercises.
content: Do THIS 15 min/Day to Improve Your Communication dramatically in 60 Days. If you do this for 60 days consistently, your articulation will get better, you will become more confident, and your grammar will improve alongside it. All you need is the free version of ChatGPT and 15 minutes on a daily basis doing these two exercises. Exercise number one: Go to ChatGPT and ask it to conduct your grammar assessment. Based on your results, ask it to create a personalized grammar exercise for you. Practice it for just 5 minutes every single day. Continue in the same chat so that ChatGPT can track your progress and gradually increase the difficulty level for you to improve. Exercise number two: Pick any news article or a piece from a book that you have. Read it carefully and then close it. Now open ChatGPT, tap the little microphone button and explain what you just read in 60 seconds entirely in your own words. Do not stop even if you are just rambling making no sense whatsoever. Ask ChatGPT to evaluate your response on clarity, on sentence formation, on vocabulary, and how well you have organized your thoughts. Do this just for 60 days and you will notice a remarkable difference in how confidently and clearly you communicate. Save this video and follow me for more such advice on your feed. Instagram reel/post by Vijay Chandola. Text / caption: Save this post. Here are the prompts: PROMPT 1: Grammar Assessment & Improvement “Act as my English grammar coach. Start by conducting a comprehensive grammar assessment covering tenses, articles, prepositions, subject-verb agreement, sentence construction, punctuation and vocabulary usage. Ask me 15 questions, one at a time. Evaluate my answers and identify my weak areas. Based on my performance, create a personalised 5-minute daily grammar practice plan. Give me exercises based on my weaknesses, evaluate my answers, explain my mistakes and gradually increase the difficulty as I improve. Track my progress throughout this conversation and reassess me periodically.” PROMPT 2: Communication & Articulation Masterclass “Act as my communication coach. I will explain a news article, a book passage or any topic in my own words using voice input. Evaluate my response on the following parameters: 1. Clarity of thought – Was I able to communicate my ideas clearly? 2. Sentence formation – Were my sentences grammatically correct? 3. Vocabulary – Did I use appropriate words and avoid unnecessary repetition? 4. Thought organisation – Were my ideas structured logically? 5. Articulation – Was I able to explain the subject smoothly without losing track? Give me a score out of 10 for each parameter. Identify my three biggest areas of improvement and show me how I could have communicated the same ideas more effectively. Be honest and constructive. Don’t just praise me. Give me specific exercises to improve with every attempt and track my progress over time.” PS: Continue using the same chat for both exercises so ChatGPT can refer to your previous attempts and help you track your improvement. 15 minutes a day. 60 days. Consistency is everything. #CommunicationSkills #EnglishGrammar #CareerGrowth PersonalityDevelopment.
